name: Higashine (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Higashine city emblem in yellow: a ring open at the top with two short rays.
history: Municipal flag of Higashine, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1960.

features.role: Higashine city emblem — a ring open at the top with two short rays
